categories.main_business_segments: Henan Sifangda Superhard Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the superhard materials industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of superhard materials and related products. Its main product categories include composite superhard materials for resource extraction and engineering construction, precision processing composite superhard materials, and CVD diamond products. These products serve industries such as oil and gas drilling, mining, automotive parts, equipment manufacturing, rail transit, stone processing, construction, and electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including polycrystalline diamond (PCD), polycrystalline cubic boron nitride (PCBN), and microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition (MPCVD) for CVD diamond production. It employs high-temperature and ultra-high-pressure processes for cobalt-based polycrystalline diamond wire drawing dies and integrates proprietary MPCVD equipment and growth processes for high-purity large-size CVD diamonds. The company emphasizes continuous R&D and innovation in high toughness, high heat resistance, and high precision superhard tools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include enterprises in oil and gas exploration and drilling, mining, automotive manufacturing, precision machining, and advanced manufacturing sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products widely used in land and offshore oilfields, shale gas extraction, coal mining, metal mining, road construction, automotive parts manufacturing, and electronics. Major end markets are China and overseas regions including Europe, America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, headquartered in the Henan Free Trade Experimental Zone, Zhengzhou. It has subsidiaries and operations in Singapore, the Cayman Islands, and the United States, focusing on export and import trade. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with significant exports to over 40 countries and regions including Europe, America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henan Sifangda operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the superhard materials supply chain. It manufactures superhard composite materials and tools, including PCD and PCBN products, and produces CVD diamonds. The company sources raw materials such as tungsten carbide and diamond micro-powders from upstream suppliers concentrated in Henan province but focuses on value-added processing, product development, and sales to end users in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, focusing on developing new products such as high toughness large-diameter PCD/PCBN blades, high heat-resistant diamond wire drawing dies, and gemstone-grade CVD diamonds. It aims to accelerate CVD diamond industrialization, enhance market competitiveness in oil and gas drilling and automotive sectors, and cultivate new applications for diamond materials. The company also emphasizes green and sustainable development, ESG performance, and organizational efficiency improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of superhard materials and related products, including composite superhard materials, precision tools, and CVD diamonds. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by distribution channels. It also receives government subsidies and other operating income related to its manufacturing activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Within China, the company is a leading player in the composite superhard materials segment, holding a dominant position in certain product categories such as PCD composite cutters for oil and gas drilling. However, globally, it faces competition from established foreign companies that dominate the mid-to-high-end composite superhard materials and tools market. The company is recognized for breaking the import-dominated high-end market in China and is expanding its international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 525 million, a slight decrease of 3.19% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 117.6 million, down 14.52%. Total assets reached RMB 2.08 billion, up 21.49% year-over-year. The company maintains a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity, though facing some pressure on profitability and cash flow due to increased operational costs and market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing technologies, and comprehensive product portfolio tailored to diverse and demanding applications. Its products offer superior wear resistance, impact resistance, and heat resistance, enabling enhanced operational efficiency and cost savings for customers in resource extraction and precision manufacturing. The company leverages its location in a major industrial cluster and its strategic focus on innovation to provide high-quality, domestically produced alternatives to imported high-end superhard materials.
